name: codemuster
description: Use CodeMuster during coding according to repository automation settings, or audit an entire codebase with tracked coverage and verified fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Settings-driven code reviews and tracked audits
interface.longDescription: Use CodeMuster proactively during coding according to repository settings: update coverage, review, or review and fix. Also map and audit whole repositories. Uses the CLI and attempts npm installation if missing. Requires terminal access.
defaultPrompt: Show CodeMuster coverage and unresolved findings.
Fix confirmed CodeMuster findings and run tests.
